ios.desc:
Fedi Archive lets you browse and search through your Fediverse archives, including those generated by Mastodon. It features full-text search over post contents and media alt text, as well as the ability to save or share any media files, and copy or open links to any posts. If you're looking for a way to browse through zip archives filled with dense, inscrutable JSON files generated by your Mastodon server, this app is for you!

The app runs entirely on-device, with no tracking, analytics, or personal information being sent anywhere.

Fedi Archive is independently developed and is not affiliated with, sanctioned, commissioned, condoned, or approved by Mastodon gGmbH or Mastodon, Inc.
